title: Target restriction transposition before computing base change
statement: Let gprime:Xprime→X, fprime:Xprime→Sprime, f:X→S and g:Sprime→S form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Choose the derived categories, pullbacks, adjunctions, and comparison mates of [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Let K be in D(X), and let W⊆U be opens of X. Let alphaU be the canonical local base-change arrow with identity coefficient map. Write pW:Wprime→Xprime, pU:Uprime→Xprime and kprime:Wprime→Uprime for the chosen pullback projections and inclusion. Let cprime: Lkprime LpU ≅ LpW be the pinned pullback composition comparison after identifying kprime≫pU=pW. Transposing alphaU followed by relative restriction under L(pW≫fprime)⊣R(pW≫fprime) equals the inverse pW,fprime pullback comparison, followed by LpW of the fprime-transpose of alphaU followed by the inverse pU,fprime direct-image comparison, then the inverse inclusion comparison at RpU LpU Lgprime K, then Lkprime of the pU counit, and finally the inclusion comparison at Lgprime K. The local base-change arrow itself is not computed. No covering or quasi-coherence hypothesis is used.

proof.text: Normalize the equality transport in the inverse-image open comparison using a named first-projection equation for relativeMVOpenLift. Congruence and proof irrelevance identify the resulting comparison with the original comparison, without changing the statement. This pins the input of congrArg and avoids reducing the chosen pullback construction during kernel checking.

Expand relativeMVRestriction. Use naturality of the composite adjunction Hom equivalence to move the incoming alphaU and inverse pU,fprime comparison to the left. Apply the mate counit identity to the final pW,fprime direct-image comparison. This replaces its composite counit by the inverse pW,fprime pullback comparison, LpW of the fprime counit, and the pW counit.

Move the Rfprime map of the adjoint restricted open counit through the fprime counit by naturality. The triangle identity cancels its pW transpose. Naturality of the inverse pullback comparison moves alphaU into the fprime Hom-equivalence transpose. The remaining factors are the three explicit target open-counit factors. This argument neither expands base change nor uses the composite prefix identity. Equal opens, empty opens and zero complexes obey the same naturality and triangle equations.

theorem relativeMV_composite_baseChange_target_transpose
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (W U : X.Opens) (i : W ≤ U) :
    let C := (schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)
    let A := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (U.ι ≫ f)).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)
    let c' := relativeMVComp (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.fst g' U.ι) ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun t : pullback g' W.ι ⟶ X' ↦ derivedPullback t)
        (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _))
    let θ := (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app K ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫
      (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app K
    ((relativeMVAdj (pullback.fst g' W.ι ≫ f')).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
          (𝟙 _) U).hom ≫
        relativeMVRestriction (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.fst g' U.ι)
          (pullback.fst g' W.ι) (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _) f'
          ((derivedPullback g').obj K)) =
    (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι) f').inv.app
      (relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K ((derivedPullback g').obj K) (𝟙 _) U).left ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' W.ι)).map
        (((relativeMVAdj f').homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
              (𝟙 _) U).hom ≫
            (relativeMVImageComp (pullback.fst g' U.ι) f').inv.app
              ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj
                ((derivedPullback g').obj K)))) ≫
      c'.inv.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback g').obj K))) ≫
      (derivedPullback (relativeMVOpenLift g' i)).map
        ((relativeMVAdj (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).counit.app
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback g').obj K))) ≫
      c'.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
